seo.title: Open-Air Bar & Patio in Mission Beach
seo.description: Explore Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego: an open-air bar, tropical dining room, outdoor patio and private event space at 3704 Mission Blvd.

hero.imageAlt: Miss B's Coconut Club teal open-air bar Mission Beach San Diego
hero.eyebrow: 3704 Mission Blvd · Mission Beach, San Diego
hero.heading: Open-Air Bar & Patio in Mission Beach
hero.subheading: Explore the open-air bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio at Miss B's Coconut Club, steps from the Pacific in Mission Beach.

sections.imageAlt: Miss B's Coconut Club open-air teal bar window Mission Beach San Diego
sections.heading: Open-Air Bar on Mission Blvd
body: The open-air teal bar is the centerpiece of Miss B's Coconut Club, connecting the indoor space with the Mission Beach patio and creating an easy indoor-outdoor setting steps from the Pacific.
The full cocktail, beer and food menus are available during service. Walk-ins are welcome at the bar.

sections.imageAlt: Miss B's Coconut Club tropical dining room mural Mission Beach San Diego
sections.heading: Tropical Dining Room
body: Inside Miss B's, the tropical dining room combines teal booth seating, the original mural, hanging plants and warm pendant lighting for seated meals, brunch and group gatherings.
The dining room can also be used for private dining and event configurations for groups up to 60 seated guests.

sections.imageAlt: Miss B's Coconut Club outdoor patio pink umbrellas Mission Beach San Diego
sections.heading: Outdoor Patio in Mission Beach
body: The outdoor patio brings the Mission Beach setting into the restaurant with pink fringed umbrellas, fire pit seating and direct access to the open-air bar.
The patio is available for private-event configurations and can accommodate groups up to 80 guests reception-style.
